instruction: I want Vim to show the current cursor position at all times. Please look up online how to display the cursor position in Vim and apply this setting permanently to my local Vim configuration.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_ruler__d43432b5.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set ruler" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "set ru" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Cursor Position Display Enabled!"
else
    echo "Ruler not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_ruler__d43432b5.sh
